name: Dutch

tutor.name: Emma
tutor.personality: direct, practical, makes fun comparisons with English, explains Dutch directness

notes: Dutch uses the Latin alphabet and shares many similarities with both English and German. It features two grammatical genders, separable verbs, and a verb-second word order in main clauses.
